verdict.rationale: Runway documents generating video from an image or a clip (docs-36), and supports video-to-video requests (docs-16). Kling 4.0 generates video from image or video references (docs-42), and Seedance 2.5 accepts a large reference budget of images and videos (docs-3), so reference-guided generation is a first-party capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that references control visual style (rather than content or motion), and any hands-on or independent corroboration of reference-to-style output quality.
